product.name: Harness AI
product.purpose: Standalone software-product development application with classic chat, provider modules, and Product Part / Cluster / Module architecture control.

rules.moduleBoundary: External access goes through each module facade.
rules.referenceOnly: CodeAI Hub can be used as reference material, but modules are written fresh.

productParts.name: Application Shell
productParts.purpose: Standalone Electron interface surface and Core supervisor/client. It owns no backend truth.

clusters.name: Electron Host
clusters.purpose: Desktop host lifecycle, Core process supervision/client bridge, and VS Code link opening. It must not compose Core or provider runtime modules in-process.

modules.name: App Bootstrap
modules.purpose: Electron lifecycle, window creation, and local app startup.

modules.name: Core Process Bridge
modules.purpose: Start, stop, restart, health-check, or connect to the local Core Runtime process through process contracts only.

modules.name: VS Code Link Opener
modules.purpose: Open absolute file links in Visual Studio Code.

clusters.name: Session Interface
clusters.purpose: Classic chat session surface and session chrome. It submits user input and renders Core read models only.

modules.name: Session Window
modules.purpose: Transcript/dialog layout, session chrome, and next-session mode panel.

modules.name: Input Controls
modules.purpose: Message input, Stop/Play controls, and busy/lock display.

modules.name: Session Telemetry
modules.purpose: Usage limits, context window, and provider/model status surfaces.

modules.name: Session Sidebar
modules.purpose: Workspace switcher, workspace session list, next-session mode entry, session rename, and Settings entry.

clusters.name: Settings Surface
clusters.purpose: Provider, localization, and recovery settings UI. It edits settings through Core contracts only.

modules.name: Provider Settings UI
modules.purpose: Provider cards, auth/model/reasoning controls.

modules.name: Localization Settings UI
modules.purpose: UI language and reasoning translation controls.

modules.name: Recovery Controls UI
modules.purpose: Core restart and recovery action surface.

productParts.name: Core Runtime
productParts.purpose: Out-of-process long-running local authority for workspaces, sessions, orchestration, provider composition, settings, localization, and workspace truth.

clusters.name: Workspace Architecture
clusters.purpose: Workspace registry, product tree storage, skeleton materialization, and file-link contracts.

modules.name: Workspace Registry
modules.purpose: Known workspaces and active workspace selection.

modules.name: Product Tree Store
modules.purpose: Read and write product-tree JSON plus Markdown projection.

modules.name: Workspace Skeleton Materializer
modules.purpose: Create filesystem structure from the approved product tree.

modules.name: Workspace Link Contract
modules.purpose: Emit file-link targets for the Application Shell.

clusters.name: Session Runtime
clusters.purpose: Session metadata, next-session mode truth, JSONL history, turn state, and UI snapshots.

modules.name: Session Registry
modules.purpose: Session metadata, create/open/rename operations.

modules.name: Session Request Handler
modules.purpose: Core-owned create/resume/send/stop routing, provider dispatch, and next-session mode truth for session actions.

modules.name: Provider Session Binding
modules.purpose: Map Core sessions to provider session ids and binding state.

modules.name: Session Event Stream
modules.purpose: Provider-neutral Core session events for Application Shell projections.

modules.name: Session History Store
modules.purpose: Append-only JSONL session history.

modules.name: Turn Lifecycle
modules.purpose: Running/idle/failure state and Stop/Continue boundaries.

modules.name: Session Snapshot Projector
modules.purpose: Read model for the Electron session UI.

modules.name: Session Reasoning Display
modules.purpose: Project provider-visible reasoning/thinking into Core dialog messages.

clusters.name: Development Orchestrator
clusters.purpose: Plan-first lifecycle, commits, scope guards, and quality gates.

modules.name: Plan Orchestrator
modules.purpose: Plan-first lifecycle and recovery state.

modules.name: Git Transaction Manager
modules.purpose: Git init, automatic commits, and clean-tree checks.

modules.name: Task Scope Guard
modules.purpose: Product Part / Cluster / Module ownership and file-scope checks.

modules.name: Quality Gate Runner
modules.purpose: Post-skeleton quality commands and hooks.

clusters.name: Intent Normalization
clusters.purpose: Normalized request envelopes for future executor dispatch.

modules.name: Intent Envelope Contract
modules.purpose: Normalized request schema.

modules.name: Normalizer Provider Runner
modules.purpose: Call a chosen provider/model for normalization.

modules.name: Execution Envelope Validator
modules.purpose: Validate normalized output before executor dispatch.

clusters.name: Settings And Localization
clusters.purpose: Settings persistence, UI localization, and reasoning translation.

modules.name: Settings Store
modules.purpose: Global and workspace settings persistence.

modules.name: Localization Runtime
modules.purpose: UI localization bootstrap and bundle state.

modules.name: Reasoning Translation Overlay
modules.purpose: Async translation of visible reasoning/thinking.

productParts.name: Provider Runtime
productParts.purpose: Independent provider adapters, provider homes/auth, usage telemetry, and provider-backed translation engines composed by Core Runtime only.

clusters.name: Provider Registry
clusters.purpose: Provider catalog, invocation profile descriptors, model descriptors, status, startup, and recovery reporting.

modules.name: Provider Registry
modules.purpose: Provider catalog, availability, and invocation profile descriptors.

modules.name: Provider Descriptor
modules.purpose: Model/reasoning capabilities and UI metadata.

modules.name: Provider Health
modules.purpose: Status, startup, and recovery reporting.

clusters.name: Provider Adapters
clusters.purpose: Independent provider adapter modules for every MVP provider. Application Shell must not instantiate them.

modules.name: Provider Adapter Contract
modules.purpose: Shared create/resume/send/subscribe/close adapter boundary used by Core.

modules.name: Claude Provider
modules.purpose: Claude provider adapter.

modules.name: Codex Provider
modules.purpose: Codex provider adapter.

modules.name: Kimi Provider
modules.purpose: Kimi provider adapter.

modules.name: GLM Native Provider
modules.purpose: GLM native provider adapter.

modules.name: GLM OpenCode Provider
modules.purpose: GLM OpenCode provider adapter.

modules.name: OpenRouter Provider
modules.purpose: OpenRouter provider adapter.

modules.name: Local Models Provider
modules.purpose: Local model provider adapter.

modules.name: Legacy Direct Provider Turn Runner
modules.purpose: Deprecated direct dispatch debt retained only until Core-owned provider dispatch replaces existing UI wiring.

clusters.name: Provider Home And Auth
clusters.purpose: Isolated provider homes, auth references, and ignored runtime files.

modules.name: Provider Home Manager
modules.purpose: Isolated provider home layout.

modules.name: Provider Auth Store
modules.purpose: API keys and auth references outside tracked workspace files.

modules.name: Provider Runtime Files
modules.purpose: Runtime caches/logs ignored from workspace truth.

clusters.name: Provider Events And Translation
clusters.purpose: Provider stream normalization, usage telemetry, and translation engines.

modules.name: Provider Event Normalizer
modules.purpose: Provider stream/event normalization.

modules.name: Usage Context Telemetry
modules.purpose: Usage limits and context-window signals.

modules.name: Provider Translation Engines
modules.purpose: Provider-backed UI/reasoning translation engines.
